mentions.description: A book titled 'The Little Chronicles of Mathematics, Data, and the Mind of Machines', a 100-section journey from counting stones to thinking silicon. Written as a storybook for curious builders, it shows how things connect across history: how math becomes language, how data becomes memory, and how machines learned to reason.
